about: The HD-2D mode's designed props for an image model (docs/HD2D.md §5b, §10): each entry is one card -- its file name in crates/ffh-play/assets/app/r3d/hd2d/art (a numbered name joins its kind's variants: hut_3 is a third hut), what to draw, its height in art pixels (the code-drawn card's, so the dressing's scale holds) and how much to deepen its middle values (tools/hd2d/art.py prop). The style is shared; tools/hd2d/local_props.py runs them through a local ComfyUI.
style: 16-bit pixel art game sprite of a single object, crisp pixels, detailed, muted earthy palette (deep olive greens, warm browns, slate greys, no neon), lit from the upper left, three-quarter top-down view as on a strategy game map, centered, the whole object in view, plain pure white background, no ground, no shadow, no text
negative: photo, 3d render, blurry, text, watermark, frame, border, multiple objects, ground plane, cast shadow, cropped
